ns2:course.label: Senior Seminar
ns2:course.description: Seminar and tutorial in selected Media and Cinema Studies topics. No graduate credit. May be repeated in the same or subsequent semesters to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing, a declared Media and Cinema Studies major, or consent of instructor.
